The comprehensive Kosmos World Atlas will turn all your virtual journeys across the Earth into a very special experience!  The digital atlas includes the most recent physical, political, and theme maps, and it shows you how beautiful our planet is.

The physical world map illustrates the altitude structures, rivers, lakes, and seas of the Earth. The political map presents all countries of the world, along with both their administrative structures and cities. The theme maps provide some clear and easy-to-understand information on some complex facts, such as the climate, the vegetation, or tectonics.
